config.label: Pane agent API key
config.description: Pane agent API key. If unset, the server auto-registers a fresh agent against the relay on first use and saves the key to the shared CLI store (~/.config/pane/config.json).

config.label: Pane relay base URL
config.description: Pane relay base URL. Defaults to the hosted relay https://relay.paneui.com; set this to point at a self-hosted relay.

config.label: Display name for the auto-registered agent on the relay
config.description: Display name for the auto-registered agent on the relay.

config.label: Registration secret, required only for relays running REGISTRATION_MODE=secret
config.description: Registration secret, required only for relays running REGISTRATION_MODE=secret.
